notes.key_messages: • Attention needs to be paid to making sure workings are carried out at a sufficient level of accuracy to ensure the accuracy of the final answer. • Candidates need to be careful to eliminate arithmetic and numerical errors in their answers. General Comments This paper covered the whole breadth of the syllabus and for those candidates who had covered the syllabus thoroughly and had practised by answering previous papers, it gave the opportunity to achieve high marks.
notes.general_comments: General Comments This paper covered the whole breadth of the syllabus and for those candidates who had covered the syllabus thoroughly and had practised by answering previous papers, it gave the opportunity to achieve high marks. General setting out was mostly satisfactory, but again it is necessary to request that candidates do not place questions, or parts of questions, side by side on the page, as this can make it much more difficult to follow Comments on specific questions Most candidates were able to make a good attempt at the first part of this question on the binomial expansion.
